# Productivity Calculator

> Free industry-specific labor, manufacturing, healthcare, and business productivity calculators with formula breakdowns and benchmark tables.

## Core Calculators

- [Productivity Calculator Home](https://productivitycalculator.work/): Unified directory of 30+ vertical productivity and efficiency calculators.
- [Labor Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/labor): Output per labor hour, unit labor cost, and shift efficiency calculator.
- [Employee Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/employee): Revenue per employee, billable utilization, and output benchmarks.
- [Manufacturing Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/manufacturing): OEE, throughput per machine hour, and scrap-adjusted productivity.
- [Physical Therapy Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/physical-therapy): Clinical treatment hours, billable units, and caseload utilization.
- [Billing Units Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/billing-units): CMS 8-minute rule and AMA timed vs. untimed CPT billing units calculator.
- [Rehab Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/rehab-productivity): PT/OT/SLP rehabilitation therapy productivity and RUG/PDPM tracking.
- [SNF Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/snf-productivity): Skilled Nursing Facility therapy productivity and concurrent treatment calculator.
- [Total Factor Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/total-factor-productivity): Cobb-Douglas TFP, multifactor productivity (MFP), and residual growth.
- [Time Efficiency Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/time-efficiency): Standard vs. actual hours efficiency ratio and variance analysis.
- [Productivity Percentage Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/productivity-percentage): Target vs. actual output percentage and period-over-period delta.
- [Productivity with Lunch Break](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/productivity-with-lunch-break): Net productive hours after unpaid meal and rest break deductions.
- [Productivity Index Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/productivity-index): Base-period indexed productivity tracking across teams and quarters.
- [Net Primary Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/net-primary-productivity): Ecology NPP = GPP - R and Light/Dark Bottle dissolved oxygen calculator.
- [Construction Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/construction): Crew labor hours per unit installed and earned-value productivity.
- [Sales Productivity Calculator](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/sales): Quota attainment, pipeline velocity, and revenue per rep.
- [Customer Support & Call Center](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/customer-support): Tickets per hour (TPH), FCR, AHT, and occupancy rate calculators.
- [Retail, Logistics & Healthcare](https://productivitycalculator.work/calculator/logistics): Picks per hour, sales per square foot, and clinical throughput tools.
